host_context.processor: Intel Core Ultra 9 285H (existing local build evidence)

openvino_runtime.distribution_note: OpenVINO's official selector lists the PIP channel as including the NPU plugin Python API. No wheel was downloaded or installed.
openvino_runtime.windows_python_support: OpenVINO 2026 system requirements list Python 3.10-3.14 for Windows.

arc_gpu.finding: OpenVINO 2026 system requirements list Intel Arc GPU Series on Windows 10/11 x64. The GPU driver is separate; docs do not give one universal numeric driver floor. Integrated Intel GPU is enumerated GPU.0 when present.

npu.driver_requirement_static: An NPU driver is required. The current OpenVINO device guide does not state a universal minimum driver version for static-shape inference.
npu.bf16: BF16 is not listed in the NPU plugin's supported inference primitive types; do not assume BF16 execution. Convert/test as F16/F32 or supported quantization.
npu.shape_support: Static input/output shapes are the general supported path. Dynamic shapes are preview-only, bounded, require Compiler-In-Plugin, and are limited to NPU40XX/Lunar Lake.
npu.dynamic_shape_scope: The 4621 requirement applies only to the bounded dynamic-shape preview, which the guide says is limited to vision models and validated on super-resolution examples. It is not a general static-inference minimum.
npu.operation_support: There is no universal per-op static whitelist for this device in the current guide. Query Core.query_model(model, NPU) and compile the specific model/shape. NPU is supported by AUTO; HETERO support is partial.

driver_assessment.provided_npu_driver_32_0_100_2267: Below the dynamic-shape preview threshold, but that threshold is not a static-model requirement. The docs do not establish that this version fails all static inference on Core Ultra 9 285H. Its compatibility with OpenVINO 2026.4.1 on this host remains unverified; do not label it incompatible solely from 4621.
driver_assessment.compiler_fallback: Default PREFER_PLUGIN uses the integrated compiler only if platform and driver compatibility conditions hold; otherwise OpenVINO falls back to Compiler-In-Driver. The documented driver v2565 boundary is specifically for Meteor Lake NPU 3720 and cannot be generalized to 285H/Arrow Lake.

latest_intel_npu_driver_reference.supported_product: Intel Core Ultra 9 Processor 285H is listed.
latest_intel_npu_driver_reference.meaning: This is a current positive compatibility reference, not an installation request. It does not define a minimum version for static inference.

generic_npu_vision_reference.limitation: This supports feasibility for a common static vision model, not the Qwen3.8 ViT or this host's exact device/driver.

documented_flow: Export or obtain an ONNX model.
Use openvino.convert_model(onnx_path) or ovc; save XML/BIN with openvino.save_model.
OpenVINO can read ONNX directly; conversion is recommended when model load latency matters.
Query NPU operation support and compile the concrete static model shape.
onnx_conversion.gguf_note: The local Qwen mmproj is GGUF, and GGUF is not among the documented direct OpenVINO model-conversion inputs. A source-framework export or ONNX version is needed; this is inferred from the documented input formats.

original_encoder.docs_description: About 0.9 GB; 27-layer ViT plus language-model projector.
original_encoder.optional_q8_encoder: Docs report a 590 MiB Q8_0 mmproj and give llama-quantize mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0.gguf Q8_0.

unsloth_ud_q4_setup.finding: The unsloth family declares the original mmproj path/repository, but sets vision=false. setup.py resolves this to vision=none and warns/off when GPU/CPU vision is requested. The Q4 docs say the encoder is not wired to this file yet.

current_helper.engine: tools/vision/strata_vision.cpp uses llama.cpp mtmd with a GGUF mmproj and the text GGUF opened vocabulary-only.
current_helper.gpu_cpu_selection: A boolean use_gpu selects mtmd GPU use; CPU mode hides CUDA before llama_backend_init. No NPU selector exists.
current_helper.server_protocol: serve/server.py starts the helper with mmproj/model paths, sends ENC <image> <output>, and consumes an SVE1 header (token count, 2D grid, embedding width) plus float32 embeddings.

strata_vision.smallest_integration_seam: A standalone OpenVINO Python worker can sit behind the server's existing Vision subprocess boundary, but must preserve READY/ENC/OK and SVE1 output shape/2D positions. It requires source/ONNX weights for the ViT+projector, matching image preprocessing/crops, static NPU shapes, and model-specific query_model plus embedding parity. This is a research candidate, not implemented or tested.

assessment: OpenVINO 2026.4.1 has a matching CPython 3.14 Windows x64 wheel, and OpenVINO documentation covers both Intel Arc GPUs and Windows NPU inference. The NPU static-shape driver floor is not specified as a universal version; 32.0.100.4621 is only a bounded dynamic-shape preview threshold for NPU40XX/Lunar Lake. For Core Ultra 9 285H with supplied 2267 driver, static compatibility with OpenVINO 2026.4.1 remains unverified; the official latest 5540 package is the current documented positive pairing. The existing Strata UD-Q4_K_XL setup currently disables vision, and its GGUF mmproj is not a direct OpenVINO conversion input.
